verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says teams can 'auto-generate release notes in pipeline settings so your changelog is always up to date,' which directly matches auto-generating a changelog per release. That is the product's own documented capability, but the support rests on a single one-line changelog claim. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how release notes are generated, what content they include and how they are formatted or edited, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
